search.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the search field at the top of the Home screen, which filters the viewer's own app tiles.

search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Home screen.

search.clear.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the × button inside Home's search field: empties the field.

search.results_one.description: Small heading over the app tiles on Home while a search is active. {{count}} is how many of the viewer's apps match.

search.results_other.description: Small heading over the app tiles on Home while a search is active. {{count}} is how many of the viewer's apps match.

grid.heading.description: Heading over the grid of app tiles on the Home screen: the apps this person keeps a tile for. The same name is used in "Add to My apps".

grid.loading.description: Read by screen readers while the grid of app tiles on Home is still loading.

grid.noMatches.text: No apps match “{{query}}”. Clear the search and try <0>Discover Communities</0> below.
grid.noMatches.description: Shown in place of Home's app tiles when the search finds none of the viewer's apps. {{query}} is what the person typed. The numbered tag highlights the name of the section further down the Home screen; use the same words as that section's heading.

grid.showAll_one.description: Button under the grid of app tiles on Home: reveals the rows of tiles that are folded away. {{count}} is the total number of the viewer's apps.

grid.showAll_other.description: Button under the grid of app tiles on Home: reveals the rows of tiles that are folded away. {{count}} is the total number of the viewer's apps.

grid.notice.offline.text: You're offline. Apps you've opened before will appear here once this device has loaded them.
grid.notice.offline.description: Shown in place of Home's app tiles when the device has no connection and no apps are stored yet.

grid.notice.loadFailed.description: Title of the error card shown in place of Home's app tiles when the list of apps could not be fetched.

grid.tile.tip.text: {{app}}. Hold or right-click for app actions
grid.tile.tip.description: Tooltip of an app's tile on the Home screen. {{app}} is the app's name; keep it first. Holding the tile or right-clicking it opens a menu of actions for that app.

grid.tile.actions.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small menu button on an app's card: opens the menu of things to do with that app.

grid.tile.remixedFrom.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small ⑂ badge on an app's tile: this app was made as a copy (a remix) of another. {{app}} is the original app's name.

grid.tile.audience.invited.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small people badge on an app's tile: the app belongs to a community people join by invitation.

grid.tile.audience.solo.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small lock badge on an app's tile: only the viewer can see and use this app.

grid.tile.retryNamed.description: Accessible name of the Retry button on a tile whose app failed to build: tries building it again. {{app}} is the app's name.

grid.tile.status.creating.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app is being set up and is not running yet.

grid.tile.status.awaitingSecrets.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app is waiting for its required secret values (API keys and the like) to be set.

grid.tile.status.error.description: Small status line under an app's name on its Home tile: the app failed to build or start.

layout.saveFailed.text: Couldn’t save your home screen layout.
layout.saveFailed.description: Brief notice when the new arrangement of tiles on Home, after a drag, could not be saved.

create.label.description: Label under the dashed + tile at the end of Home's grid: starts a new project (an app and the community that builds it).

create.tip.description: Tooltip of the + tile at the end of Home's grid.

create.disabledHint.text: View your app allowance or request more slots.
create.disabledHint.description: Last sentence of the + tile's tooltip when the viewer has used up the number of apps they may create: what pressing it does instead. A slot is room for one app.

create.lockedTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the + tile at the end of Home's grid when the viewer cannot create another app right now. {{hint}} is one whole sentence saying what pressing the tile does ("View your app allowance or request more slots.").

myApps.added.description: Brief notice after an app's tile was added to the viewer's Home. "My apps" is the name of that section.

myApps.removed.description: Brief notice after an app's tile was taken off the viewer's Home. "My apps" is the name of that section.

myApps.updateFailed.description: Brief notice when adding an app to My apps, or removing it, did not go through. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

leave.afterUnpin.title.description: Title of the question asked right after someone removed an app from My apps while still a member of its community. {{community}} is the app's name. "Leave" means stop being a member.

leave.afterUnpin.private.text: It’s off your Home screen. Leaving also ends your access until someone invites you back.
leave.afterUnpin.private.description: Body of the "Leave … too?" question when the app's community is private.

leave.afterUnpin.public.text: It’s off your Home screen. You can stay a member, or leave and stop proposing and voting on its changes.
leave.afterUnpin.public.description: Body of the "Leave … too?" question when the app's community is public. "Changes" is a noun.

leave.afterUnpin.confirm.description: Confirming button of the "Leave … too?" question: stop being a member of the app's community. A verb.

leave.afterUnpin.stay.description: The other button of the "Leave … too?" question: keep the membership and close the question.

leave.confirm.title.description: Title of the question asked when someone presses "Joined" on an app to stop being a member of its community. {{community}} is the app's name.

leave.confirm.private.text: You will lose access to it until someone invites you back.
leave.confirm.private.description: Body of the "Leave …?" question when the app's community is private.

leave.confirm.public.text: You won’t be able to propose or vote on its changes until you join again.
leave.confirm.public.description: Body of the "Leave …?" question when the app's community is public. "Changes" is a noun.

leave.confirm.button.description: Confirming button of the "Leave …?" question: stop being a member of the app's community. A verb.

membership.joined.description: Brief notice after the viewer joined an app's community. {{community}} is the app's name.

membership.left.description: Brief notice after the viewer stopped being a member of an app's community. {{community}} is the app's name. "Left" is the past of leave, not a direction.

membership.joinFailed.description: Brief notice when joining an app's community failed. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

membership.leaveFailed.description: Brief notice when leaving an app's community failed. {{reason}} is the server's own error message, or a code such as "HTTP 500".

menu.updated.description: Line in the header of an app tile's menu: when the app's latest version went live. {{when}} is a short relative time such as "3d ago" or "just now".

menu.details.label.description: Item in an app tile's menu on Home: opens the app's page in Discover.

menu.details.tip.text: Version, status and everything you can do with this app
menu.details.tip.description: Tooltip of the "App details" item in an app tile's menu.

menu.github.label.description: Item in an app's menu: opens the app's source code repository on GitHub in a new tab.

menu.github.tip.description: Tooltip of the "View on GitHub" item in an app's menu. "Open" is a verb.

menu.myApps.add.description: Item in an app's menu: puts a tile for the app on the viewer's Home. "My apps" is the name of that section.

menu.myApps.remove.description: Item in an app's menu: takes the app's tile off the viewer's Home. "My apps" is the name of that section.

menu.myApps.showAgainTip.text: Show this app in My apps again. You keep your builder access either way.
menu.myApps.showAgainTip.description: Tooltip of "Add to My apps" in an app's menu, for someone who builds the app and had hidden its tile.

menu.myApps.hideTip.text: Hide this app from My apps. It stays live and you keep your builder access.
menu.myApps.hideTip.description: Tooltip of "Remove from My apps" in an app's menu, for someone who builds the app. "Live" means still running for its users.

menu.notifications.label.description: Item in an app's menu: opens the choices of what this app may notify the viewer about.

menu.notifications.tip.text: Choose what this app can notify you about, here and on your phone.
menu.notifications.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Notifications" item in an app's menu.

menu.widget.edit.description: Item in an app's menu in the iPhone app, when the app is already on the Homeroom widget: reveals the strip on Home where the widget's apps are arranged. Homeroom is the product's name.

menu.widget.add.description: Item in an app's menu in the iPhone app: adds the app to the Homeroom widget on the phone's home screen. Homeroom is the product's name.

menu.phoneHome.add.description: Item in an app's menu in the Android app: puts a shortcut to the app on the phone's home screen.

menu.phoneHome.addFailed.description: Brief notice when putting an app on the phone's home screen, or on the Homeroom widget, failed. {{reason}} is the error the phone reported.

menu.install.label.description: Item in an app's menu in a phone browser: opens the page that explains how to install the app on the phone's home screen with its own icon.

menu.install.tip.text: Put this app on your phone’s home screen with its own icon
menu.install.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Add to Home Screen" item in an app's menu.

menu.retry.description: Item in the menu of an app that failed to build, shown to its creator: tries building and starting the app again.

menu.buildLog.label.description: Item in the menu of an app whose last build failed: opens the log of that build. "Build" is a noun.

menu.buildLog.tip.text: See why the last build/deploy failed
menu.buildLog.tip.description: Tooltip of "View build log" in an app's menu when the server gave no failure reason of its own.

menu.checkUpdates.label.description: Item in an app's menu, for administrators: checks whether the app's repository has a newer version to deploy.

menu.checkUpdates.checking.description: Replaces the label of "Check for updates" in an app's menu while the check is running.

menu.checkUpdates.failedHttp.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" failed and the server gave no message. {{status}} is the HTTP status number, such as 500.

menu.checkUpdates.failed.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" could not reach the server. {{reason}} is the browser's own error message.

menu.remix.label.description: Item in an app's menu: makes the viewer's own copy of the app to change freely. A verb.

menu.remix.sub.description: Second line, and tooltip, of the "Remix" item in an app's menu.

menu.lock.lock.description: Item in an app's menu, for administrators: from then on a change to the app also needs an administrator's yes vote. "Lock" is a verb.

menu.lock.unlock.description: Item in an app's menu, for administrators, when the app is locked: lifts the extra administrator vote. A verb.

menu.lock.lockTip.text: Lock this app. An admin yes vote will also be required to merge changes.
menu.lock.lockTip.description: Tooltip of "Lock app" in an app's menu. To merge a change is to accept it into the app.

menu.lock.unlockTip.text: App locked: merges also need an admin yes vote. Click to unlock.
menu.lock.unlockTip.description: Tooltip of "Unlock app" in an app's menu. A merge is the acceptance of a change into the app.

menu.lock.failedHttp.description: Brief notice when locking or unlocking an app failed and the server gave no message. {{status}} is the HTTP status number.

menu.lock.failed.description: Brief notice when locking or unlocking an app could not reach the server. {{reason}} is the browser's own error message.

menu.settings.description: Item in an app's menu, for people who manage the app: opens the app's settings dialog.

menu.report.description: Item in an app's menu: reports the app to Homeroom's moderators as breaking the rules. "Report" is a verb.

check.noDetails.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" when the server's answer said nothing about the outcome.

check.noDrift.title.description: Title of the question asked after "Check for updates" found the app already runs its repository's newest version (commit).

check.noDrift.message.text: Force a rebuild anyway? (Useful if env vars or platform code changed.)
check.noDrift.message.description: Body of the question asked after "Check for updates" found nothing new. "Env vars" are the app's environment variables.

check.noDrift.confirm.description: Confirming button of the "Force a rebuild anyway?" question: builds and deploys the app again. A verb.

check.rebuild.started.text: Rebuild started. Watch the version pill.
check.rebuild.started.description: Brief notice after a forced rebuild of an app began. The version pill is the small chip showing the app's version, where progress appears.

check.rebuild.failed.description: Brief notice when a forced rebuild of an app could not be started. {{reason}} is the server's own error message.

check.redeployed.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" found a newer version and deployed it. {{sha}} is the first seven characters of that version's commit id.

check.inFlight.text: A redeploy is already in progress for this app.
check.inFlight.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" when the app is already being deployed again.

check.firstSeen.text: Recorded current SHA ({{sha}}). Future drift will trigger a redeploy.
check.firstSeen.description: Brief notice after the first "Check for updates" on an app. {{sha}} is the first seven characters of the current commit id. Drift means the repository moving ahead of what is deployed.

check.fetchFailed.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" could not read the app's repository. {{reason}} is the server's own error message.

check.fetchFailedUnknown.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" could not read the app's repository and the server gave no reason.

check.invalidRepo.text: This app has an invalid repo URL.
check.invalidRepo.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" when the address of the app's repository is not usable.

check.rebuildFailed.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" found a newer version but deploying it failed. {{from}} and {{to}} are seven-character commit ids, the deployed one and the newer one. {{reason}} is the server's own error message.

check.rebuildFailedUnknown.text: Drift detected ({{from}} → {{to}}) but redeploy failed: unknown error
check.rebuildFailedUnknown.description: Brief notice when "Check for updates" found a newer version, deploying it failed and the server gave no reason. {{from}} and {{to}} are seven-character commit ids.

check.finished.description: Brief notice after "Check for updates" ended with an outcome this screen has no sentence for. {{status}} is the server's own status code, such as no_change.

time.justNow.description: A relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu: less than a minute ago. Lower case because it follows another word.

time.minutesAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of minutes; "m" abbreviates minutes.

time.minutesAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of minutes; "m" abbreviates minutes.

time.hoursAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

time.hoursAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

time.daysAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

time.daysAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

time.monthsAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of months; "mo" abbreviates months.

time.monthsAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of months; "mo" abbreviates months.

time.yearsAgo_one.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of years; "y" abbreviates years.

time.yearsAgo_other.description: A compact relative time inside "Updated …" in an app tile's menu. {{count}} is a number of years; "y" abbreviates years.

widget.heading.description: Heading of the strip on Home, in the iPhone app, where the apps shown on the Homeroom home-screen widget are arranged. Homeroom is the product's name.

widget.help.toggle.text: How to add the widget to your home screen
widget.help.toggle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the small ⓘ button beside the "Homeroom widget" heading: shows or hides the instructions.

widget.help.steps.text: <0>Add the widget to your home screen:</0> touch and hold an empty area of your iPhone home screen, tap <1>Edit</1> → <2>Add Widget</2> (or the <3>+</3>), search for <4>Homeroom</4>, pick a size and tap <5>Add Widget</5>. The apps below appear on it automatically.
widget.help.steps.description: Instructions shown in the widget strip on Home in the iPhone app. Every numbered tag is emphasis. "Edit" and "Add Widget" are the names of buttons in iOS: use the names iOS shows in your language. Homeroom is the product's name; keep it.

widget.close.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Done" button on the widget strip on Home: hides the strip.

widget.hint.withTiles.text: Drag tiles to reorder. Drag cards from My apps here to add them.
widget.hint.withTiles.description: Hint under the app tiles in the widget strip on Home. "My apps" is the name of the grid below it.

widget.hint.empty.text: Drag a card from My apps here (or use its menu) to add it to the Homeroom widget on your home screen.
widget.hint.empty.description: Hint in the widget strip on Home while it holds no apps. "My apps" is the name of the grid below; Homeroom is the product's name.

widget.tile.remove.description: Tooltip of the ✕ button on an app's tile in the widget strip on Home: takes that app off the Homeroom widget.

widget.tile.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of the ✕ button on an app's tile in the widget strip on Home. {{app}} is the app's name.

widget.removeFailed.description: Brief notice when taking an app off the Homeroom widget failed. {{reason}} is the error the phone reported.

widget.reorderFailed.description: Brief notice when saving the new order of apps on the Homeroom widget failed. {{reason}} is the error the phone reported.

widget.heal.skippedMechanism.description: Diagnostic outcome shown in Settings, on the "Widget icons" row, after a colon: the last pass that refreshes the widget's icons did not run because this device does not use the widget. Lower case because it follows a colon.

widget.heal.skippedBridge.description: Diagnostic outcome shown in Settings, on the "Widget icons" row, after a colon: the last icon refresh did not run because the app cannot talk to the phone's shortcut feature. Lower case because it follows a colon.

widget.heal.nothing.description: Diagnostic outcome shown in Settings, on the "Widget icons" row, after a colon: the last icon refresh found every icon up to date. Lower case because it follows a colon.

widget.heal.sent_one.description: Diagnostic outcome shown in Settings, on the "Widget icons" row, after a colon: the last icon refresh sent {{count}} icons to the widget. Lower case because it follows a colon.

widget.heal.sent_other.description: Diagnostic outcome shown in Settings, on the "Widget icons" row, after a colon: the last icon refresh sent {{count}} icons to the widget. Lower case because it follows a colon.

widget.heal.sentRefused_one.description: Diagnostic outcome shown in Settings, on the "Widget icons" row, after a colon: the last icon refresh sent {{sent}} icons and the phone refused {{refused}} more. Lower case because it follows a colon.

widget.heal.sentRefused_other.description: Diagnostic outcome shown in Settings, on the "Widget icons" row, after a colon: the last icon refresh sent {{sent}} icons and the phone refused {{refused}} more. Lower case because it follows a colon.

gettingStarted.regionLabel.description: Accessible name of the card at the top of Home that lists a new member's first steps.

gettingStarted.title.description: Title of the card at the top of Home that lists a new member's first steps, while some are still to do.

gettingStarted.doneTitle.description: Title of the Getting started card on Home once every step is done.

gettingStarted.close.description: Accessible name of the × button on the finished Getting started card: removes the card from Home. "Close" is a verb; "Getting started" is the card's title.

gettingStarted.seeChallenges.description: Button on the finished Getting started card: opens the Challenges tab, where the newly unlocked challenges are.

gettingStarted.counter.progress.description: Line under the Getting started card's title. {{done}} is how many steps are finished and {{total}} how many there are.

gettingStarted.counter.withPoints_one.description: Line under the Getting started card's title once steps have paid points. {{done}} and {{total}} count steps; {{points}} is the points earned so far, already formatted ("1,500"); "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number of points, for the plural.

gettingStarted.counter.withPoints_other.description: Line under the Getting started card's title once steps have paid points. {{done}} and {{total}} count steps; {{points}} is the points earned so far, already formatted ("1,500"); "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number of points, for the plural.

gettingStarted.counter.celebrate_one.description: Line under "You’re all set" on the finished Getting started card. {{done}} and {{total}} count steps; {{points}} is the points earned, already formatted ("1,500"); the numbered tag shows them in green. Keep the + sign. {{count}} is the same number of points, for the plural.

gettingStarted.counter.celebrate_other.description: Line under "You’re all set" on the finished Getting started card. {{done}} and {{total}} count steps; {{points}} is the points earned, already formatted ("1,500"); the numbered tag shows them in green. Keep the + sign. {{count}} is the same number of points, for the plural.

gettingStarted.unlock.oneStep_one.text: One more step unlocks {{count}} more challenge
gettingStarted.unlock.oneStep_one.description: Line beside a lock at the foot of the Getting started card when exactly one step is left. {{count}} is how many further challenges finishing the card unlocks.

gettingStarted.unlock.oneStep_other.text: One more step unlocks {{count}} more challenges
gettingStarted.unlock.oneStep_other.description: Line beside a lock at the foot of the Getting started card when exactly one step is left. {{count}} is how many further challenges finishing the card unlocks.

gettingStarted.unlock.twoSteps_one.text: Two more steps unlock {{count}} more challenge
gettingStarted.unlock.twoSteps_one.description: Line beside a lock at the foot of the Getting started card when exactly two steps are left. {{count}} is how many further challenges finishing the card unlocks.

gettingStarted.unlock.twoSteps_other.text: Two more steps unlock {{count}} more challenges
gettingStarted.unlock.twoSteps_other.description: Line beside a lock at the foot of the Getting started card when exactly two steps are left. {{count}} is how many further challenges finishing the card unlocks.

gettingStarted.unlock.finishAll_one.text: Finish all {{total}} to unlock {{count}} more challenge
gettingStarted.unlock.finishAll_one.description: Line beside a lock at the foot of the Getting started card when three or more steps are left. {{total}} is the number of steps on the card; {{count}} is how many further challenges finishing them unlocks.

gettingStarted.unlock.finishAll_other.text: Finish all {{total}} to unlock {{count}} more challenges
gettingStarted.unlock.finishAll_other.description: Line beside a lock at the foot of the Getting started card when three or more steps are left. {{total}} is the number of steps on the card; {{count}} is how many further challenges finishing them unlocks.

gettingStarted.unlocked_one.description: Line beside an open lock on the finished Getting started card. {{count}} is how many challenges are now available.

gettingStarted.unlocked_other.description: Line beside an open lock on the finished Getting started card. {{count}} is how many challenges are now available.

gettingStarted.reward.tour.text: No points · ticks when you finish or skip it
gettingStarted.reward.tour.description: Small grey line under the tour step on the Getting started card: the tour pays no points, and the step is marked done once the tour was finished or skipped.

gettingStarted.reward.earned_one.description: Small green line under a finished step on the Getting started card. {{points}} is the points that step paid, already formatted ("1,500"); keep the + sign. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

gettingStarted.reward.earned_other.description: Small green line under a finished step on the Getting started card. {{points}} is the points that step paid, already formatted ("1,500"); keep the + sign. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

gettingStarted.reward.earnsPoints_one.description: Small amber line under an unfinished step on the Getting started card: what finishing it pays. {{points}} is the number of points as the organisers wrote it; "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

gettingStarted.reward.earnsPoints_other.description: Small amber line under an unfinished step on the Getting started card: what finishing it pays. {{points}} is the number of points as the organisers wrote it; "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

gettingStarted.reward.earns.description: Small amber line under an unfinished step on the Getting started card. {{reward}} is the reward as the organisers wrote it, unit included, for example "500 pts".

gettingStarted.join.note.text: Homeroom and Just-you projects don’t count.
gettingStarted.join.note.description: Small grey line under the "join a community" step on the Getting started card: joining Homeroom's own project or a project only the viewer can see does not complete the step. Homeroom is the product's name; "Just you" is the name of the audience of a project only its owner sees.

gettingStarted.join.detailWithNote.text: {{detail}} Homeroom and Just-you projects don’t count.
gettingStarted.join.detailWithNote.description: Small grey line under the "join a community" step on the Getting started card. {{detail}} is the organisers' own sentence describing the step, ending in its own full stop; keep it first. Homeroom is the product's name; "Just you" is the name of the audience of a project only its owner sees.

gettingStarted.step.tour.short.description: Button with a play icon beside the tour step on the Getting started card: starts the one-minute tour of Homeroom. A verb.

gettingStarted.step.tour.long.description: Tooltip of the "Start" button beside the tour step on the Getting started card.

gettingStarted.step.tour.aria.description: Accessible name of the "Start" button beside the tour step on the Getting started card.

gettingStarted.step.join.short.description: Button beside the "join a community" step on the Getting started card: opens Discover, where a community can be joined. A verb.

gettingStarted.step.join.long.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Join" button on the Getting started card.

gettingStarted.step.joinFirst.description: Small grey line under a later step on the Getting started card while the viewer has joined no community yet: that step cannot be done before joining one.

gettingStarted.step.discover.short.description: Button beside a step on the Getting started card when no app is suggested for it: opens the Discover tab. Use the same word as the Discover tab.

gettingStarted.step.discover.long.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Discover" button on the Getting started card. Discover is the name of the tab that lists every app.

gettingStarted.step.try.findApp_one.text: Find an app on Discover and spend {{count}} second in it.
gettingStarted.step.try.findApp_one.description: Small grey line under the "try an app" step on the Getting started card when no app is suggested. {{count}} is the number of seconds to spend. Discover is the name of a tab.

gettingStarted.step.try.findApp_other.text: Find an app on Discover and spend {{count}} seconds in it.
gettingStarted.step.try.findApp_other.description: Small grey line under the "try an app" step on the Getting started card when no app is suggested. {{count}} is the number of seconds to spend. Discover is the name of a tab.

gettingStarted.step.vote.findApp.text: Find an app on Discover and see what people are building.
gettingStarted.step.vote.findApp.description: Small grey line under the "vote" step on the Getting started card when no app is suggested. Discover is the name of a tab.

gettingStarted.step.suggest.findApp.text: Find an app on Discover and tell its builders what would make it better.
gettingStarted.step.suggest.findApp.description: Small grey line under the "send feedback" step on the Getting started card when no app is suggested. Discover is the name of a tab.

gettingStarted.step.other.open.description: Button beside a step on the Getting started card that the organisers gave no button text: goes to the place where the step is done. A verb.

gettingStarted.step.try.short.description: Button beside the "try an app" step on the Getting started card: opens the suggested app. A verb.

gettingStarted.step.try.long.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Try" button on the Getting started card. {{app}} is the suggested app's name.

gettingStarted.step.try.detail_one.description: Small grey line under the "try an app" step on the Getting started card. {{count}} is the number of seconds to spend; {{app}} is the suggested app's name.

gettingStarted.step.try.detail_other.description: Small grey line under the "try an app" step on the Getting started card. {{count}} is the number of seconds to spend; {{app}} is the suggested app's name.

gettingStarted.step.suggest.short.description: Button beside the "send feedback" step on the Getting started card: opens the suggested app with its feedback form. A verb.

gettingStarted.step.suggest.long.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Suggest" button on the Getting started card. {{app}} is the suggested app's name. "Change" is a noun.

gettingStarted.step.suggest.detail.text: Tell {{app}}’s builders what would make it better.
gettingStarted.step.suggest.detail.description: Small grey line under the "send feedback" step on the Getting started card. {{app}} is the suggested app's name.

gettingStarted.step.vote.short.description: Button beside the "vote" step on the Getting started card: opens the list of changes waiting for the viewer's vote in an app. A verb.

gettingStarted.step.vote.long.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Vote" button on the Getting started card. {{app}} is the name of the app whose changes are waiting.

gettingStarted.step.vote.waiting_one.description: Small grey line under the "vote" step on the Getting started card. {{count}} is how many proposed changes (noun) wait for a vote; {{app}} is the app's name.

gettingStarted.step.vote.waiting_other.description: Small grey line under the "vote" step on the Getting started card. {{count}} is how many proposed changes (noun) wait for a vote; {{app}} is the app's name.

gettingStarted.step.vote.waitingElsewher.text: Nothing in {{app}} yet; {{count}} change is waiting in {{otherApp}}.
gettingStarted.step.vote.waitingElsewher.description: Small grey line under the "vote" step on the Getting started card when the app the viewer joined has nothing to vote on but another does. {{app}} is the joined app's name, {{otherApp}} the other app's, and {{count}} how many proposed changes (noun) wait there.

gettingStarted.step.vote.waitingElsewher.text: Nothing in {{app}} yet; {{count}} changes are waiting in {{otherApp}}.
gettingStarted.step.vote.waitingElsewher.description: Small grey line under the "vote" step on the Getting started card when the app the viewer joined has nothing to vote on but another does. {{app}} is the joined app's name, {{otherApp}} the other app's, and {{count}} how many proposed changes (noun) wait there.

gettingStarted.step.look.short.description: Button beside the "vote" step on the Getting started card when nothing is waiting for a vote: opens an app's workshop to see what is being built. A verb.

gettingStarted.step.look.long.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the "Look" button on the Getting started card. {{app}} is the app's name; its community is what is building.

gettingStarted.step.look.detail.text: Nothing is waiting for approval yet. See what people are building.
gettingStarted.step.look.detail.description: Small grey line under the "vote" step on the Getting started card when no proposed change is waiting for a vote anywhere.

waitlist.regionLabel.description: Accessible name of the card on Home where someone invited into a private community can join the waiting list to make their own apps.

waitlist.title.description: Title of the waitlist card on Home.

waitlist.join.button.description: Main button of the waitlist card on Home: starts joining the waiting list for creating apps.

waitlist.join.note.text: We're letting people in a few at a time.
waitlist.join.note.description: Small note under the "Join the waitlist" button on Home.

waitlist.listed.byText.text: We’ll text you when your spot is ready.
waitlist.listed.byText.description: Shown on the waitlist card once the viewer is on the list with a phone number only: they will get a text message.

waitlist.listed.byEmail.text: We’ll email you when your spot is ready.
waitlist.listed.byEmail.description: Shown on the waitlist card once the viewer is on the list with an email address.

waitlist.addEmail.link.description: Link on the waitlist card for someone listed by phone only: opens the form to add an email address as well.

waitlist.sooner.title.description: Line at the foot of the waitlist card, beside a link to a short survey that can move the viewer up the list.

waitlist.sooner.answer.description: Link beside "Want in sooner?" on the waitlist card: opens the four-question survey.

waitlist.sooner.edit.description: Link beside "Want in sooner?" on the waitlist card once the survey was answered: reopens it.

waitlist.email.titleJoin.description: Title of the email step of the waitlist card on Home, for someone not on the list yet.

waitlist.email.titleAdd.description: Title of the email step of the waitlist card on Home, for someone already listed by phone.

waitlist.email.leadOwn.text: With your email, or another one.
waitlist.email.leadOwn.description: Line under the title of the waitlist card's email step when the account already has an email address, which is filled in below. It completes the title "Join the waitlist".

waitlist.email.leadAdd.text: Add your email. We’ll email you a 6-digit code.
waitlist.email.leadAdd.description: Line under the title of the waitlist card's email step when the account has no email address.

waitlist.email.label.description: Label of the email address field on the waitlist card.

waitlist.email.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the email address field on the waitlist card: an example of an address. Keep it a valid-looking address.

waitlist.email.submitJoin.description: Submit button of the waitlist card's email step when the address is the account's own, so no code is needed.

waitlist.email.submitCode.description: Submit button of the waitlist card's email step when the address must be confirmed: sends a 6-digit code to it.

waitlist.email.privacy.text: We use it to tell you when your spot is ready, and you can sign in with it. Nobody else sees it.
waitlist.email.privacy.description: Small note under the email field on the waitlist card. "It" is the email address.

waitlist.email.notNow.description: Link under the waitlist card's email step: goes back without adding an address.

waitlist.code.title.description: Title of the waitlist card's step where the emailed code is typed in.

waitlist.code.sent.text: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 15 minutes.
waitlist.code.sent.description: Line under "Check your email" on the waitlist card. {{email}} is the address the code went to.

waitlist.code.label.description: Label of the field for the 6-digit emailed code on the waitlist card. A noun.

waitlist.code.submit.description: Submit button of the waitlist card's code step: confirms the code and joins the list.

waitlist.code.otherEmail.description: Link under the code field on the waitlist card: goes back to enter a different address.

waitlist.code.resend.description: Link under the code field on the waitlist card: emails a fresh code to the same address.

waitlist.error.join.text: Could not join the waitlist. Try again.
waitlist.error.join.description: Error on the waitlist card when joining failed and the server gave no message of its own.

waitlist.error.code.text: Could not check that code. Try again.
waitlist.error.code.description: Error on the waitlist card when the emailed code could not be checked and the server gave no message of its own.

verify.regionLabel.description: Accessible name of the card on Home that asks a member to verify their identity.

verify.title.description: Title of the card on Home that asks a member to verify their identity.

verify.lead.text: Add your phone number to vote on public apps and get the full AI budget. Nobody sees your number.
verify.lead.description: Text under "Verify your account" on Home when verifying by phone number is offered. The AI budget is the allowance of AI use each account gets.

verify.reason.text: Verified accounts vote on public apps and get the full AI budget.
verify.reason.description: Text under "Verify your account" on Home when phone verification is not offered; instructions to link other accounts follow it.

discover.heading.description: Heading of the section of Home that shows a rail of app cards to try.

discover.fallbackTitle.description: Title of Home's Discover block when the server sent none. Not shown as a heading today; kept with the block's data.

discover.browseAll.label.description: Link at the right end of the "Discover Communities" heading on Home, and its accessible name: opens the Discover screen with every app.

discover.browseAll.tip.text: Browse every app in the directory
discover.browseAll.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Browse all apps" link on Home.

discover.empty.title.description: First line of the card shown in Home's Discover Communities section when there are no apps to suggest. The whole card links to the Discover screen.

discover.empty.detail.text: Browse the directory to find an app to try.
discover.empty.detail.description: Second line of the card shown in Home's Discover Communities section when there are no apps to suggest.

discover.card.addTip.description: Tooltip of the round + button on an app's card in Home's Discover Communities rail: puts a tile for the app in My apps.

discover.card.addedTip.text: Added. Tap to remove from My apps
discover.card.addedTip.description: Tooltip of the round check button on an app's card in Home's Discover Communities rail when the app is already in My apps.

discover.card.addNamed.description: Accessible name of the round + button on an app's card in Home's Discover Communities rail. {{app}} is the app's name; "My apps" is the name of the grid on Home.

discover.card.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of the round check button on an app's card in Home's Discover Communities rail when the app is already in My apps. {{app}} is the app's name.

discover.card.contributors_one.description: Small line at the bottom of an app's card in Home's Discover Communities rail. {{count}} is how many people have contributed to the app.

discover.card.contributors_other.description: Small line at the bottom of an app's card in Home's Discover Communities rail. {{count}} is how many people have contributed to the app.

challenges.heading.description: Heading of the section of Home that lists the season's challenges: tasks that earn points.

challenges.fallbackTitle.description: Title of Home's Challenges block when the server sent none. Kept with the block's data.

panels.fallbackTitle.description: Title of a block on the Home screen whose own title is missing. A block of Home, not the phone's home-screen widget.

challenges.open.label.description: Link at the right end of the "Challenges" heading on Home, and its accessible name: goes to the Challenges tab of the Leaderboard screen. "Open" is a verb.

challenges.open.tip.text: Go to the Challenges tab on the Leaderboard screen
challenges.open.tip.description: Tooltip of the "Open challenges" link on Home.

challenges.empty.text.text: No challenges are running right now
challenges.empty.text.description: Shown in Home's Challenges section between seasons. The line is a button that goes to the Challenges tab.

challenges.empty.tip.text: Go to the Challenges tab on the Leaderboard screen
challenges.empty.tip.description: Tooltip of the "No challenges are running right now" line on Home.

challenges.empty.label.text: No challenges are running right now. Go to the Challenges tab on the Leaderboard screen
challenges.empty.label.description: Accessible name of the "No challenges are running right now" line on Home: the state, then what pressing it does.

challenges.fold.showLess.description: Button under Home's list of challenges when it is unfolded: folds it back to the first few.

challenges.fold.seeAllCount_one.description: Button under Home's list of challenges: unfolds the whole list. {{count}} is how many challenges are open.

challenges.fold.seeAllCount_other.description: Button under Home's list of challenges: unfolds the whole list. {{count}} is how many challenges are open.

challenges.fold.seeAll.description: Button under Home's list of challenges when their number is not known: unfolds the whole list.

challenges.fold.collapseTip.description: Tooltip of the "Show less" button under Home's list of challenges. "Widget" means this block of the Home screen.

challenges.fold.expandTip.text: Show every challenge in this widget
challenges.fold.expandTip.description: Tooltip of the "See all challenges" button on Home. "Widget" means this block of the Home screen.

challenges.onboardingNote.text: Finish Getting started to unlock the rest of the season.
challenges.onboardingNote.description: Note under Home's list of challenges while the first challenges are unfinished. "Getting started" is the title of the card of first steps.

challenges.group.setup.description: Heading over the group of a new member's first challenges, in Home's Challenges section.

challenges.group.week.description: Heading over the group of challenges that end with the current week, in Home's Challenges section.

challenges.group.always.description: Heading over the group of challenges with no deadline, in Home's Challenges section. "Open" is an adjective: available.

challenges.group.other.description: Heading over the season's remaining challenges, in Home's Challenges section.

challenges.group.done.description: Heading over the challenges the viewer has completed, in Home's Challenges section.

challenges.group.noDeadline.description: Small note at the right of the "Always open" heading in Home's Challenges section, where other groups show the time left. Lower case, like the times it stands in for.

challenges.timeLeft.hours_one.description: Time remaining for a challenge or a group of challenges on Home, under a day. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

challenges.timeLeft.hours_other.description: Time remaining for a challenge or a group of challenges on Home, under a day. {{count}} is a number of hours; "h" abbreviates hours.

challenges.timeLeft.days_one.description: Time remaining for a challenge or a group of challenges on Home. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

challenges.timeLeft.days_other.description: Time remaining for a challenge or a group of challenges on Home. {{count}} is a number of days; "d" abbreviates days.

challenges.row.done.description: State shown on a challenge's card on Home: the viewer has completed it.

challenges.row.started.description: State shown on a challenge's card on Home: the viewer has earned something from it but not completed it.

challenges.row.notStarted.description: State shown on a challenge's card on Home: the viewer has made no progress on it.

challenges.row.countOf.description: Progress shown on a challenge's card on Home: {{current}} done out of the {{target}} needed.

challenges.row.countOfUnit.description: Progress shown on a challenge's card on Home: {{current}} done out of the {{target}} needed. {{unit}} is the organisers' own word for what is counted, such as "apps".

challenges.row.earned_one.description: Line on a completed challenge's card on Home. {{points}} is the points it paid, already formatted ("1,500"); "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

challenges.row.earned_other.description: Line on a completed challenge's card on Home. {{points}} is the points it paid, already formatted ("1,500"); "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

challenges.reward.points_one.description: A challenge's reward on its card on Home. {{points}} is the number of points as the organisers wrote it; "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

challenges.reward.points_other.description: A challenge's reward on its card on Home. {{points}} is the number of points as the organisers wrote it; "pts" abbreviates points. {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

challenges.summary.progress.description: Summary of Home's Challenges block: {{done}} challenges completed out of {{total}}.

challenges.summary.withPointsLeft_one.description: Summary of Home's Challenges block: {{done}} challenges completed out of {{total}}, and {{points}} points still to be earned, already formatted ("1,500"). {{count}} is the same number of points, for the plural.

challenges.summary.withPointsLeft_other.description: Summary of Home's Challenges block: {{done}} challenges completed out of {{total}}, and {{points}} points still to be earned, already formatted ("1,500"). {{count}} is the same number of points, for the plural.

challenges.season.done.description: Follows a count such as "3/12" at the top of Home's Challenges section, and completes the screen-reader phrase "3 of 12 done": that many challenges are completed. Lower case because it follows the numbers.

challenges.season.doneIn.description: Follows a count such as "3/12" at the top of Home's Challenges section, and completes the screen-reader phrase "3 of 12 done in …". {{season}} is the season's name. Lower case because it follows the numbers.

challenges.season.doneInFirst.description: Follows a count such as "1/4" at the top of Home's Challenges section while the first challenges are unfinished. "First challenges" is the name of that group; use the same words as its heading. Lower case at the start because it follows the numbers.

tone.cream.description: Name of a card colour, a pale warm off-white: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.yellow.description: Name of a card colour, a soft yellow: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.orange.description: Name of a card colour, a soft orange: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.coral.description: Name of a card colour, a pinkish orange: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.pink.description: Name of a card colour, a soft pink: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.purple.description: Name of a card colour, a soft purple: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.indigo.description: Name of a card colour, a blue-violet: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.blue.description: Name of a card colour, a soft blue: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.teal.description: Name of a card colour, a blue-green: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.mint.description: Name of a card colour, a pale green: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.sage.description: Name of a card colour, a greyish green: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.

tone.gray.description: Name of a card colour, a neutral grey: tooltip and accessible name of its swatch in the featured illustration editor.
